claim: The one-click demo uses sample data and never changes the real household board.
sandbox: fresh browser context; create real data, change and reset the three-card demo, leave demo, and assert real data is unchanged

claim: Completed chores rotate to the next eligible person and skip dated absences.
sandbox: fresh /demo board; add an absence spanning the next due date, complete the chore, and assert the absent person is skipped

claim: Exports preserve the full board as JSON, import into a fresh browser, and preserve every activity value in CSV.
sandbox: fresh /demo board; add a person, compare the JSON with every stored field, compare every CSV value, then import into a separate clean browser context

claim: A shared link contains a read-only current-board snapshot without history.
sandbox: fresh /demo board; open its generated fragment URL in a new page and assert assignments appear without actions or history

claim: Household data stays in the browser unless exported or shared; Fair Turn has no accounts, tracking, scores, or public profiles.
where: landing facts, footer, settings, privacy page, README
sandbox: fresh /demo board; observe completion and reset requests, assert every request is same-origin, and assert the interface has no account or score controls

claim: The installed app works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: fresh /demo visit; wait for service-worker control, set the context offline, reload, and assert the sample board and offline state

claim: The free board supports four people and six chores; Plus costs $12 once, removes those limits, and adds an eight-week outlook.
where: landing facts, Plus panel, terms, README
sandbox: start at /demo; prove both free gates, then intercept verification for a fixture license on a real board, add a fifth person and seventh chore, and assert the outlook reaches eight weeks

claim: Fair Turn installs as a standalone PWA.
sandbox: fresh /demo visit; validate the standalone manifest, maskable icon, and ready service-worker registration

claim: The board supports keyboard use, reduced motion, dark theme, and a 390 px screen.
sandbox: fresh /demo at 390 px with reduced motion and dark preference; use Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, and Escape through sections and a dialog; assert focus, announcements, no overflow, both themes, and zero serious/critical Axe findings
